service_at_issue: Skilled nursing home health services (daily injections) for a beneficiary in an assisted living facility, Feb-Dec 2004
outcome_note: The Council reversed the ALJ and held the services covered because, giving great weight to prior favorable homebound decisions and with no change in his condition, the beneficiary remained confined to the home.
facts: Due to his functional limitations, the beneficiary was unable to reposition himself independently and was fully dependent on assistance for all activities of daily living, including bathing and dressing. Nursing notes indicate that the VNA of Chittenden and Grand Isle Counties, Inc. provided intermittent skilled nursing services to the beneficiary during the periods of service at issue.
Appellant argues that the Plans of Care and the record as a whole support a finding that beneficiary was “confined to the home.”
Several nursing notes indicated that the beneficiary was “not homebound - leaves daily for social and medical appointments.”
The beneficiary’s primary diagnosis did not change and he was hospitalized four times during the dates of service at issue.
